obernants.domain: Documented admitted API and ordered validation errors
obernants.observation_scope: Return values, explicit state and named assertions
obernants.operator: Universe: admitted input sequences paired with candidate four-vector trees. Absent outputs include cycles, missing indices, nonreciprocal links, roots other than the leftmost global minimum, and any subtree root differing from that interval's leftmost minimum. These recursive interval constraints characterize the unique tree on lawful Ord. Over-cap input paired with Ok is absent; allocator refusal may yield AllocationFailed.
obernants.approximation_semantics: Source-derived mathematical target; finite correspondence, not a proof
obernants.assumptions: Lawful ordering where applicable; stated numeric bounds; no allocator fault injection

obernants.operator: Given an observed tree retain all sequences whose leftmost-minimum recursive decomposition is that tree. Monotone value embeddings preserve the tree, so [1,2] and [8,9] share a right chain; [1,1] does too. Shape loses magnitudes and some equality information. Empty output has length zero; errors retain broad input/allocator fibers.
